meta.title: One Guest Message, Start to Finish — Hybrid AI (Neuro-Symbolic) Flow

views.label: 1. AI Extraction + Symbolic Guardrails
views.note: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite extracts Trip JSON (with 60s Circuit Breaker); Symbolic Verifier enforces verbatim evidence, protects staying guests from diver clauses, and triggers NEVER RE-ASK when diveNotes is present.

views.label: 2. Hospitality Replier + Symbolic Fact Gate
views.note: Hybrid Replier crafts a warm concierge response verified by verifySynthesizedReply() Fact Gate (blocking unauthorized price quotes or count drift, with deterministic fallback) + Staff Alerts (30% agency / split-day).

cards.title: Phase 1 — Symbolic Extraction & NEVER RE-ASK Guardrails
items: Every date & count is verified against the guest's verbatim text (enforceVerbatimEvidence); narrative diveNotes & specialRequests are preserved as inferred
Diver-Clause Lookahead (DIVE_CLAUSE_AFTER_NOUN): '1 person dives day 1, 5 people dive both days' never overwrites staying guest count (guests: 4)
NEVER RE-ASK Rule: When diveNotes captures a split-day schedule, the bot skips re-asking divers, diveFrom, and diveTo

cards.title: Phase 1 & 2 — Post-Generation Fact Gate & Staff Alerts
items: Hybrid AI Replier (synthesizeHospitalityReply) writes warm concierge acknowledgments that must pass verifySynthesizedReply() before sending
100% hard block on unauthorized currency/price quotes ($, ₱, PHP, USD, VND), false booking confirmations, or room/night drift (instant deterministic rollback)
Automatic Staff Alerts (getStaffAlerts): appends 📋 Partner / Agency Rate (30% discount) and 📋 Custom Dive Schedule directly to the handoff summary

cards.title: Production Resilience (WhatsApp <4s) & Odoo ERP Handoff
items: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite promoted to Primary on WhatsApp with a 60s Circuit Breaker in createResilientProvider (eliminating 20s webhook timeouts on 502 gateways)
Odoo ERP Handoff (buildOdooHandoffPayload): routes enquiries into auto_estimate_ready, manual_staff_review, or incomplete_enquiry
Verified by 235 / 235 unit & fuzz tests across 16 test suites (npm run verify) + live WhatsApp & Web Console validation
